facts.fact: Mali's specialised cybercrime tribunal sentenced journalist Abdrahamane Keita, publication director of Le Temoin, to two years in prison and 1 million CFA francs damages for a remark about Kidal on a TV programme on 4 June 2026, on charges of regionalist remarks, undermining the State's credit and national unity, and spreading false information through an information system; he had been detained since June and the defence intends to appeal.
